description: Skip-Bo by Mattel, the popular family card game is now on Windows 8! Test your skills, get into the action, and place all your cards in sequential order. Keep an eye on your opponents though, because the first player to get rid of all the cards in their stockpile wins. Challenge your friends and get in on the fun! Game Features: Test your skills with 3 difficulty levels and 9 challenging opponents. Go on amazing streaks and watch your opponents burst with anger.
